attributes.title: Star of the North Meeting 2027
attributes.summary:
Star of the North 2027 takes place April 22 to 24, 2027, at the Saint Paul RiverCentre. Registration and the hotel block open January 5, 2027; the early-bird deadline is March 5, the hotel reservation deadline April 2 and the cancellation deadline April 9.

Registration is free for MDA member dentists. Out-of-state ADA members pay $100 and non-member dentists $200; hygienists, assistants, therapists and other team members pay $40. Individual courses carry separate tuition.

The program offers fundamental CE (clinical topics, infection control, recordkeeping, ethics, medical emergencies and similar) plus elective CE. All eligible attendees also receive 3.0 elective CEs for attending and visiting the exhibit hall. The Minnesota Dental Association is an ADA CERP Recognized Provider.
